notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, impersonate=chrome120) worked cleanly on every page requested - no Akamai/DataDome block encountered on this IT site (unlike the sister UK site SR89, which was fully Akamai-blocked). robots.txt (200) explicitly names anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web and then 'Allow: /', and the generic User-agent:* block only disallows cart/checkout/login/search-results/etc, none of which apply to category pages, so tier (a) was fully compliant and sufficient; tiers (b)/(c) were not needed. TREE: built from the union of (1) robots.txt-listed https://www2.hm.com/it_it.sitemap.xml -> https://www2.hm.com/it_it.pages.department.0.xml (confirmed https://www2.hm.com/it_it/home.html is the Home department) -> 30 it_it.pages.subdepartment.N.xml shards (2852 URLs total) filtered to the 151 URLs under /it_it/home/acquista-per-prodotto/ (the 'shop by product' branch, mirroring the standard mega-menu taxonomy used on the UK site), and (2) each category page's own rendered mega-menu links (extracted from the served HTML), which surfaced additional alias URLs. The parallel 'acquista-per-stanza' (shop-by-room) branch exposes the same underlying products filtered by room rather than a distinct taxonomy, so it was treated as a duplicate navigation path and excluded per the duplicate-record rule (textile.md S30/storage.md S38), matching the UK worker's precedent. QTY: every leaf page's server-rendered HTML embeds a Next.js JSON payload containing 'productListingData':{'totalHits':N,...}; this was extracted directly from the tier-(a) HTML response (not estimated), and every leaf's <link rel=canonical> and <h1> were checked to confirm they match the requested node before recording qty, per the anti-bad-slug rule. DEDUP: several nav paths are pure aliases of one canonical page and were collapsed to one record: accessori-cucina/asciugapiatti.html and accessori-cucina/grembiuli.html both canonicalize to cucina-camera-da-pranzo/asciugapiatti.html and .../grembiuli.html (same totalHits); all three servizi-da-tavola/* URLs (tovaglie-e-runner, tovagliette-americane, tovaglioli) canonicalize to the identical cucina-camera-da-pranzo/* URLs; the mega-menu's 'textiles/asciugamani.html', 'textiles/plaid.html', 'textiles/tappetini-bagno.html', 'textiles/tende-per-la-doccia.html', 'textiles/tovaglie-e-runner.html', 'textiles/tovaglioli.html', 'textiles/asciugapiatti.html' and 'arredamento/cuscini-per-sedie.html' are all mega-menu aliases of nodes already recorded under accessori-bagno/biancheria-letto/cucina-camera-da-pranzo/textiles (identical totalHits, confirmed by fetch) and were not re-added. textiles/seat-cushions-lookbook.html duplicates textiles/cuscini-per-sedie.html (same totalHits=13, near-identical h1) and reads as an editorial 'lookbook' page rather than a standard listing, so it was dropped per the View-All/promotional-page exclusion rule. GROUPING: parent pages accessori-bagno/asciugamani.html (Towels, totalHits=188), contenitori/cestini.html (Storage Baskets, totalHits=61), and all top-level landing pages (contenitori.html, textiles.html, accessori-bagno.html, biancheria-letto.html, cucina-camera-da-pranzo.html) canonicalize to their own 'vedi-tutto' (View All) page or otherwise have valid subcategories underneath them, so per the parent-category-URL rule they were recorded as grouping rows (qty=null, link=null) with only their leaf children carrying qty/link; the parent-total-vs-children-sum mismatches observed (e.g. Towels 188 vs 50+32+93+3=178; Storage Baskets 61 vs 35) were left unresolved per the project note that parent totals are not guaranteed supersets of children. EXCLUDED (neither Textile nor Storage): the entire arredamento (Furniture) branch including arredamento/contenitori.html (h1 confirmed 'Mobili' = Furniture; wardrobes/cabinets/shelves explicitly under the Furniture URL branch, storage.md S21/S27), illuminazione (Lighting), decorazioni (wall/decor: vasi, specchi, cornici, portacandele, candele, posters, vassoi, accessori-decor, decorazioni-da-parete - Wall Decor/Decorative Accessories territory), piante (plants/flowers), profumi-per-casa (home fragrance/candles/diffusers), pacchetti-regalo (gift wrap), pigiami (pajamas - sleepwear apparel, not home textile), premium (a curated cross-category collection page, not a standard subcategory), collezione-casa (promotional collection landing page), capi-per-cani (dog apparel - pet clothing, explicitly excluded), all cucina-camera-da-pranzo/servizi-da-tavola non-textile tableware (articoli-in-vetro/glassware, caraffe, libri-di-cucina/cookbooks, piatti/plates, posate/cutlery, set-piatti, taglieri/chopping boards, tazze/mugs, vassoi/trays), bambini-neonati/decorazioni, giocattoli (toys), mobili-cameretta (nursery furniture), and stoviglie-attrezzi-cucina (kids kitchen tableware/tools, non-textile), and every vedi-tutto/view-all page. accessori-bagno/accessori.html (h1 'Accessori per il bagno', totalHits=83) was excluded as too generic to classify from the URL/h1 alone (mixes soap dispensers, toothbrush holders etc. with unclear textile/storage split), matching the UK worker's precedent of excluding the equivalent bath-shower/accessories.html. contenitori/attrezzi-cucina.html (h1 'Attrezzi da Cucina' = kitchen tools, ambiguous-sounding) was kept as Storage at MEDIUM confidence because its own categoryId is explicitly 'ORGANIZE&STORAGE:KITCHENSTORAGE' (the site's own hierarchy places it under the Storage department, not Cooking&Dining) - trusted the site's own classification per the ambiguity-handling order in storage.md S42. contenitori/mensole-da-parete.html (Wall Storage/shelving units) was kept as Storage at MEDIUM confidence for the same reason (categoryId 'ORGANIZE&STORAGE:WALLSTORAGE') despite the general shelving ambiguity in storage.md S18. cucina-camera-da-pranzo/tovagliette-americane.html (categoryId literally says COASTERS but h1 clearly reads 'Tovagliette Americane' = Placemats, a clean single-product-type page, unlike the UK site's combined coasters+placemats page) was recorded as Textile at HIGH confidence on the strength of the h1/URL, not the internal categoryId label. Kids & Baby items (bambini-neonati/*) canonicalize cross-department to /it_it/bambini/arredamento-cameretta/*.html (the Kids department) but are reachable via Home's own 'acquista-per-prodotto' navigation and rendered with Home-relevant h1 text (e.g. 'Asciugamani per bambini e neonati'), so - matching the UK worker's inclusion of the equivalent 'Kids & Baby' node - they were kept as Home-department nodes using the Home-nav URL (not the cross-department canonical).
